name: David Singleton
subject: the method you call Leadership Architecture

beats.hook: Leadership Architecture is your own name for the work. Leaders come to you once the decisions get hard.
beats.identity: I find the ones who'd be ringing you. I did it for a coach in this city who closed 6 of the 9 meetings I set up.
beats.offer: I've already got 10 names for you. Real people here, picked one at a time.
beats.cta: 15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.
beats.ps: ps: no pitch deck behind this, and nothing to unsubscribe from.
